(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A cooling system installable within a structure wall, comprising: in a housing, the housing disposed between a pair of studs of the wall, a water reservoir; a pump; a pad; a water distributor; a motor; and a fan, wherein the studs are spaced no more than sixteen inches on center.

(Currently Amended) Claim 4: The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the pump brings water from the water reservoir to the water distributor and the water distributor distributes the water to the pad thereby moistening the pad, and at least some of the water flows back to the reservoir for recirculation.

(Currently Amended) Claim 6: The cooling system of claim 5, wherein the fan causes the cooled air to flow through an opening that is structured for directing airflow from the cooling system into an indoor area.

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing includes a front cover that is removable for access to the components within the housing.

(Currently Amended) Claim 15: A cooling system kit, comprising: the cooling system of claim 1; mounting elements capable of attaching the cooling system to a structure wall; and a ventilation grill. 

(Previously presented) Claim 17: A cooling system, comprising: a mounting structure that is configured to be installed within a structure wall, the cooling system being adapted for evaporatively cooling an indoor area.
